body.statement: SPEC-4.2-17: A candidate that is not admitted has a verdict, kept in the report: `PENDING` (an acceptance is missing), `OVERCLAIMED` (wrong filer, wrong basis, order), `MISSING_EVIDENCE`, `UNMET_CONDITION`, `UNVERIFIED` (the basis could not be validated here).
